verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a capable editor and real-time multiplayer editing, but nothing says which of these are available on a free plan. The only pricing-page snippet (spline-docs-33) lists features such as exports, version history and Team Library without saying which tier includes them. Collaboration docs that are not tied to any plan cannot be credited toward a free-tier story.

support.subject: As a designer, the free tier supports real design work — usable editor and collaboration without a paid seat
